text: Barilla Spaghetti is a product in the Pantry category and is made by the brand Barilla. Rao's Homemade Marinara Sauce is also a Pantry product, made by the brand Rao's. Both are staple ingredients for Italian pasta dishes.
Signature Farms Ground Beef 80/20 and Johnsonville Italian Sausage are Meat & Seafood products. BelGioioso Grated Parmesan Cheese is a Dairy product used to finish pasta dishes.

The Barilla brand originates from Parma, Italy, where it has produced pasta since 1877. Rao's originates from New York City as a famed Italian restaurant brand. BelGioioso cheese originates from Wisconsin, USA.

The Spaghetti Bolognese recipe uses Barilla Spaghetti, Rao's Homemade Marinara Sauce, Signature Farms Ground Beef 80/20, Johnsonville Italian Sausage, BelGioioso Grated Parmesan Cheese, Bertolli Extra Virgin Olive Oil, Hunt's Whole Peeled Tomatoes, Fresh Garlic Bulb, Yellow Onion, Signature Select Italian Bread, O Organics Baby Spinach.
